canvas-workspace 1.0.0

- Initial release providing core canvas workspace capabilities: image generation, editing, pushing, and canvas state APIs.
- Supports Qwen as built-in sample scripts (text-to-image, image editing); allows extension to other models by scripting.
- Provides comprehensive setup instructions for environment variables and permanent user configuration across platforms.
- Handles user intents automatically based on keywords, including recognizing canvas image file URLs for advanced operations.
- Includes detailed command-line usage and capability boundaries for clarity and safe operation.
